description_en: ThisPhalcāis located in the south-east corner of Subāḥā Ṭola and was originally built in 1952 CE with three bays. It was dismantled in 1992 CE and integrated into a three-storied concrete building keeping the earlier three bays open (cf.Bāsukala and Gutschow2019).  The Phalcā is now used by Subāḥāḥ Ṭola Development Committee, a non-profit local organisation working for the area development (Source: a local resident of the area, Maharjana, age 69). Its upper floor has become a training space (ofdhimayanddhāḥmusic, flute etc.) for the Subāhāḥ Ṭola’s youth. One of the rooms of this Phalcā is occupied by Gajānana Maḥcā Pūcaḥ, also a non-profit and non-governmental organisation working for the local children (Source: a member of Gajānana Maḥcā Pūcaḥ, Maharjana, age 22). According to the elderly people of Subāhāḥ Ṭola, this Phalcā neither has aguṭhīnor any religious activity takes place here.
description_ne: सुबाहाः टोलको उत्तर–पूर्वी कुनामा यो फल्चा अवस्थित छ । विगत यो परम्परागत शैलीमा बनेको तीन कवलको फल्चा हुने गर्दथ्यो । यसको निर्माण सन् १९५२ मा भएको थियो भने सन् १९९२ मा पूर्णतः भत्काई यहाँ कंक्रिडको नयाँ संरचना खडा गरिएको हो (B. Bāsukala & Gutschow2019) । हाल फल्चा भएको क्षेत्रफल सहित दक्षिणतिरको जग्गा गाभेर तीन तले संरचना बनाइएको छ । विगत फल्चा भएको ठाउँमा तीन कवल निकाली खुला छाडिएको छ । सुबाहाःका बृद्धबृद्धाहरू यस फल्चासंग सम्बन्धित कुनै गुठी एवं सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि नभएको बताउछन् । फल्चामाथि बनेको नयाँ भवन सुबाहाः टोल विकास सँस्थानले कार्यलयको रूपमा प्रायोग गर्दै आएको छ । सँस्थानले भवनको प्रयोग सामाजिक कल्याणको निम्ति गर्दै आएको छ (Local knowledge, local resident, Maharjana, age 69) । भवनको माथिल्लो तल्ला सुबाहाः टोलका नयाँ पुस्तालाई भजन, धिमय् बाजा, बाँसुरी बाजा, धाः बाजा आदि  प्रशिक्षण गर्नको निम्ति सदुपयोग हुँदै आएको छ । यो बाहेक भवनको एक कोठा  गजानन मचा पुच:ले प्रयोग गर्दै आएको छ । यस संस्थाले पनि टोलका बालबालिकाको हितोपर काम गर्दै आएको छ (Local knowledge, member of the pucaḥ, Maharjana, age 22) ।
references: Sources and references Sources B. Bāsukala & Gutschow 2019

historical_events.event_description: Bāsukala & Gutschow(2019) mention that the Phalcā was originally built in 1952 CE. However, they do not validate their claim through any documented evidence.

The Phalcā was dismantled in 1992 CE and integrated into a three-storied concrete building keeping the earlier three bays open. The Subāhāḥ Ṭola Development Committee had managed the reconstruction project with the financial support from Lalitpur Sub-metropolitan City. The local community also donated for this purpose.
